summary: Iteration 27 — Re-validated OurRealm Phase 2/3 after the InstallPrompt webdriver-bypass + RealmDetail Add-widget toolbar fixes. The blocker from iteration 26 is FULLY RESOLVED. Findings: (1) InstallPrompt is gone — page.locator('[data-testid="install-prompt"]').count()===0 on /realms, /realms/dj, /friends, /messages, /admin, /admin/support. (2) /realms sidebar fully working: realms-sidebar + sort chips recent/favorite/alpha + realms-sidebar-search + 9 realm-card-* tiles in the Discover pane. (3) /realms/dj renders realm-banner, realm-chat-layout, realm-widgets-grid, realm-widgets-toolbar with the three new chips realm-widget-add-poll / -announcements / -rules. (4) RealmPollWidget Edit→Save flow WORKS — POST /api/communities/realm/dj/widgets/{wid}/poll/options → 200, edit form closes, the new 4th option 'New Option Phase2' appears in the read-only view. The previous iteration-26 'edit form never mounts' issue was actually a click-coordinate problem (playwright's positional click landed near the bottom-nav 'Discover' tab and routed away). Confirmed by using el.click() via page.evaluate which fires the React handler directly. (5) Poll Vote works — POST /poll/vote → 200, realm-poll-total goes from '0 votes' to '1 vote'. (6) Widget resize cycles 5 distinct gridColumn/gridRow combinations ['span 3|span 1','span 1|span 3','span 1|span 1','span 1|span 2','span 2|span 2'] with PATCH /widgets/{wid} → 200 on every click. (7) Add Poll widget via toolbar — POST /api/communities/realm/dj/widgets → 200, poll-widget count went 1→2, screenshot shows 3 widget tiles on the grid (2 polls + 1 announcement). (8) /messages, /admin, /admin/support, /friends ALL load with proper authenticated content (AuthContext rehydration via localStorage('ourrealm.access') is working). (9) MessagingPopupContext: messaging-popup-layer mounted globally, 3 friend-message-* buttons exist on /friends (support, tftwo, stealth). BUT the multi-window DM cascade CANNOT be exercised from /friends because the friend-message-{username} button is wired to `navigate(\`/messages?to=${username}\`)` instead of `openDM()` — see Friends.jsx:276. Floating-dm-window-* never mounts from the friend rows.

ui_bugs.issue: HTML5 drag-reorder cannot be triggered via dispatched DragEvents in tests because the onDragStart handler uses React useState(dragId), and synthetically firing dragstart→dragover→drop in the same JS tick keeps dragId === null when onDrop runs (React state hasn't flushed). The native browser drag (real mouse) would work because of natural delays. POST /widgets/reorder was never called during my drag-dispatch attempt. This is not necessarily an app bug; the implementation is correct, but it makes the flow effectively un-testable from playwright unless we either expose a non-drag fallback (e.g. up/down chips on each tile) OR break the handler to read from event.dataTransfer instead of relying on a React state update between dragstart and drop. RECOMMEND adding 'move-up' / 'move-down' arrow chips on each admin tile that call the same reorder endpoint — testable AND keyboard-accessible.

The 'Message' button on each friend row calls navigate('/messages?to=' + username) instead of useMessagingPopups().openDM(friend). As a result no floating-dm-window-{username} is ever pushed onto the messaging-popup-layer from /friends, and the multi-window cascade test (stack 2 popups, drag header, minimize, close, Esc) is unreachable from the canonical entry point the spec describes. openDM is currently only wired up in RealmDetail (People panel). Fix: in Friends.jsx:274-278, replace onClick={() => navigate(`/messages?to=${f.username}`)} with onClick={() => openDM(f)} (and import useMessagingPopups). Or expose a second affordance like an avatar-click that opens the popup while keeping the deep-link as a power-user route.

integration_issues.issue: Could not stack 2 popups → could not validate independent drag/minimize/close/Esc behavior end-to-end via /friends. The MessagingPopupContext itself looks correct (layer mounted, components properly testid'd) — it's purely an entry-point wiring miss in Friends.jsx.
Could not confirm POST /widgets/reorder fires from the UI because of the React-state-during-drag synth-event limitation (above).

action_items: [HIGH] Wire useMessagingPopups().openDM into the Friends page so the 'Message' chip opens a floating-dm-window-<username> popup (current behavior navigates to /messages). This is the only remaining blocker for the multi-window cascade spec. Suggested patch in /app/frontend/src/pages/Friends.jsx around line 274-278: import { useMessagingPopups } from '@/contexts/MessagingPopupContext', then const { openDM } = useMessagingPopups(), then change the onClick to openDM(f).

[MEDIUM] Add tiny 'move-up' / 'move-down' chips (e.g. realm-widget-move-up-<wid>) per admin tile in RealmWidgetGrid to make reorder reachable without HTML5 drag — also helps keyboard / a11y users and makes the POST /widgets/reorder flow deterministically testable.

[INFO] iteration-26's 'edit form never mounts' was a false negative caused by playwright clicking at a y-coordinate (~1033) that was hitting the bottom-nav 'Discover' tab below the viewport. The actual code is correct — el.click() via page.evaluate works perfectly. No app change needed for that bug.
critical_code_review_comments: RealmPollWidget.jsx — solid. Save flow goes POST /widgets/{wid}/poll/options, propagates `data` via onChanged, closes editing. No regression vs iter-26 design.

RealmWidgetGrid.jsx — onDragStart sets React state setDragId; onDrop reads that state. This works fine with real user drags but is brittle for headless synthetic DragEvents because React batches the setState. Consider stashing the drag source on event.dataTransfer (e.dataTransfer.setData('widget-id', w.id)) AND in state — onDrop can then fall back to dataTransfer if state is empty. Better testability without changing UX.
Friends.jsx:276 — friend-message-* should open the floating DM popup, not deep-link to /messages, per Phase-3 spec. One-line fix described in action items.
MessagingPopupContext.jsx — well-built (Esc closes focused popup, cascade math, mobile fallback). No issues.
RealmDetail.jsx — realm-widgets-toolbar exposes the 3 add chips correctly, only renders for admins; integrates with grid via POST /widgets. Good.

rca of the issue: iter-26 root cause: playwright's positional click on realm-poll-edit-save (button at y≈1033) was being captured by the bottom-nav 'Discover' tab overlay rather than the actual button. Force=True bypasses overlay interception checks but still routes the click to the topmost element at the coordinate, so the InstallPrompt fix alone wasn't enough — the bottom nav remained interceptable. Workaround used here: dispatch the click directly on the element via page.evaluate(el.click()), which fires the React onClick synchronously on the intended target. App code is fine; this was a test-coordinate quirk. The InstallPrompt fix itself is correct and has unblocked everything else.
